Program Description

Griffith's Bachelor of Acting is a highly practical and skill intensive program that will prepare students to forge a life-long career across stage and screen. The program focuses on developing both the individual and the actor through ensemble building, collaborative laboratories, industry-led workshops and public performances.

This boutique program is offered to a small number of high quality performers and is designed around four key pillars: core craft; context; repertoire; and industry engagement. Under the direction of renowned teachers and performers, students will undertake intensive training in acting, voice and speech, singing, movement and dance.

The Bachelor of Advanced Business (Honours) is designed to deliver a thorough understanding of the complex concepts facing organisations today whilst allowing customisation toward the business skill of the student's choice. This new degree takes them through a unique skill set that will give them a competitive edge in the employment market. Students will be equipped with the skills necessary to plan and conduct research in business and government, and will be well-placed for positions in the private, not-for-profit, and public sectors. Delivered using the latest innovations in learning, courses/subjects will be integrated with first-hand work experiences and organisational simulations, so students will apply the latest academic learning in workplace environments.

This degree is designed to allow students from all business disciplines to commence in the same foundation year and then specialise in the business application of their choice. So, whether students want to be an accountant, an advertising executive, an international business consultant or an entrepreneur; all they need to do is enrol and customise as they go. In third and fourth year, students will choose a thesis which will further develop and demonstrate their proficiency and application in their chosen area. Students can also apply to take an internship or study overseas as part of their thesis, helping them graduate with advanced skills that will ensure they stand out in the employment market.

The Griffith University Masters Qualifying Program provides students with an opportunity to upgrade their prior study to meet the academic and/or English language requirements for direct admission to a Griffith University Masters program.

The Masters Qualifying Program comprises one trimester of full-time study. The program aims to provide students with the knowledge, values and competencies required for successful completion of studies at postgraduate level in Australia.

Arts, Education and Law

The Masters Qualifying Program may provide a pathway to the Arts, Education and Law Masters programs listed below.

At the point of application, students will be assessed for their eligibility for admission to the Masters program. Students will receive a packaged offer for the Masters Qualifying Program and the approved Masters program*.

  • Master of Visual Arts (5663) - South Bank
  • Master of Design (5720) - South Bank
  • Master of Screen Production (5736) - South Bank

The Juris Doctor is a professional law degree that provides comprehensive education in legal principles, analysis and practice. Students study core areas such as constitutional law, contracts, criminal law, property law, torts, civil procedure, legal ethics and legal research and writing.

Through case studies, advocacy exercises, practical assignments and experiential learning opportunities, students develop skills in critical thinking, legal reasoning, negotiation, oral advocacy and professional communication. Depending on the institution, students may also pursue specialized electives, clinics, internships or moot court activities.

Graduates may pursue careers in legal practice, government, business, public policy, advocacy and non-profit organizations. Additional licensing examinations, practical training and other regulatory requirements must typically be completed to practise law in the relevant jurisdiction.
9ey6:
The Juris Doctor – International Law is a professional law degree that provides a comprehensive foundation in legal principles and practice while allowing students to develop specialized knowledge of international legal systems. Core studies may include constitutional law, contracts, criminal law, property law, torts, administrative law, legal ethics, and legal research and writing.

The international law focus may explore public and private international law, international human rights, global trade and investment, international dispute resolution, humanitarian law and the role of international institutions. Through case analysis, advocacy exercises, research assignments and experiential learning, students strengthen their legal reasoning, negotiation, communication and professional-practice skills.

Graduates may pursue opportunities in legal practice, government, international organizations, multinational corporations, non-governmental organizations, policy development and global advocacy. Completion of the degree does not automatically authorize legal practice; graduates must meet the licensing and professional admission requirements of the relevant jurisdiction.
9ey5:
The Juris Doctor – Migration Law is a professional law degree that provides comprehensive legal education with opportunities to develop specialized knowledge of immigration, refugee, citizenship and migration law. Students build a strong foundation in core legal areas such as constitutional law, contracts, criminal law, property law, torts, administrative law, legal ethics, and legal research and writing.

The migration law focus explores topics such as visa and residency frameworks, refugee protection, citizenship, border regulation, administrative decision-making, human rights and judicial review. Through case analysis, advocacy exercises, practical assignments and experiential learning, students develop skills in legal reasoning, client communication, negotiation, research and professional practice.

Graduates may pursue careers in immigration and refugee law, government agencies, migration consultancy, community legal services, policy development, advocacy and international organizations. Completion of the degree does not automatically authorize legal practice; graduates must satisfy the licensing and professional admission requirements of the relevant jurisdiction.

Program Description

In this program, students will study a wide ranging and diverse base of specialist health management courses. If students are a graduate or manager in health, aged or community care services and they want to develop their skills and understanding of contemporary health or social care management issues, these degrees will help students achieve their goals. Through flexible teaching and research options, students will learn about key areas of health sector policy, governance, operations and evidence-based practice management.

Students will develop skills and knowledge in current management theory and practice, develop your leadership skills and style and gain an in-depth understanding of health workforce planning. Students will also learn about managing human resources, planning and implementing health programs, and managing performance and health budgets from respected industry practitioners and academics. Additionally, students will develop skills in strategic decision making and change management and an understanding of the role of innovation and the application of technology in health services management. Students will develop research and project management skills that will provide a sound basis for their current work role and their future endeavours.

Through a project directly relevant to your organisation's strategic direction, students will develop research and project management skills.

Program Description

Students will receive a rounded professional architectural education with strength in design-research. Students can choose to focus on sustainable design, urban design, history/theory or design practice. The research-based approach to architectural design in this degree will help students develop the capacity to pose original questions and to investigate, analyse and appraise current information and understandings. Research-led design will underpin career-long self-directed learning of a critical-reflective nature.
